svg.title: Truth tags by repository
svg.desc: In place: 15 repository and tag pairs measured, over 5 repositories. Each cell is that repository's share of the tag's measured conditions met, darker for more. A hatched cell was not measured there, never read as zero. Rows run from the highest Step down, and a Step of ? was not measured.
svg.text: One row per repository, one column per truth tag, by Step
